messages:
Maya S: who’s up for a lunchtime 3-mile loop + kettlebell quick ladder at 12:15? thinking park loop then a 12-minute AMRAP with KBs. low-key, all levels welcome 🏃‍♀️🏋️
Diego R: count me in :running_man: I can do 12:15. which KB weights should I bring?
Maya S: sweet. if you have a 12 or 16kg that’d be perfect. I’ll bring a 8kg for warmups.
Jen L: does the route include the stairs by the west entrance? I’m still nursing my ankle :grimacing:
Olivia T: good question — last time stairs sneaked up on us.
Maya S: no stairs this time, promise. plan: north entrance -> lakeside path -> hill climb @ mile 2 (short, steep) -> loop back.
Samir K: I can bring a 16kg and a 12kg. also happy to stash an extra mat.
Jen L: okay I’ll bring my shoes and a band for warmup. can I duck out after the run to hit the climbing wall?
Diego R: @Jen L yep! the climbing meetup is usually around 1pm, you’ll have time.
wellness-bot: Reminder: submit receipts for wellness reimbursements by 03/31 to get reimbursed for gym classes and gear. :receipt:
Olivia T: who wants coffee before? there’s a new espresso pop-up by the north entrance.
Maya S: 12:00 coffee pre-run? meet by the bench. quick dynamic warmup at 12:10 then out at 12:15.
Samir K: +1 for coffee. I’ll bring the 16kg and a couple of towels.
Diego R: route snippet for anyone running GPS: `N entrance -> Lakeside Path (2.6mi) -> Summit Hill -> Back loop`
Jen L: awesome. see y’all — bring water and layers. :thumbsup:
Maya S: perfect. see you at noon. if anything changes I’ll DM the group.
Olivia T: bringing snacks for post-run sugar boost :banana:
Samir K: leg day, but make it fun. 😅
Maya S: Kettle bells and bananas — Redwood fitness breakfast of champions :grin:
